# Zoom / warp speed

Rushes into the image with radial speed streaks from a center, then the next image arrives out of the same streaks and settles to its size.

<EffectDemo effect="zoom-transition" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { zoomTransition } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/zoom-transition';

const effect = zoomTransition({ preset: 'warp' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.center = [0.5, 0.5]`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type    | Default      | Range   | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------- | ------- | ------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `center`  | [x, y]  | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1   | Point the zoom rushes toward (UV).                                                                                                                             |
| `zoom`    | number  | `0.5`        | 0 – 6   | How far the old image zooms in as it leaves. Strong zooms sweep detail across the screen quickly: keep them for transitions longer than a second (WCAG 2.3.1). |
| `streaks` | number  | `0.4`        | 0 – 0.9 | Length of the speed streaks at the middle, toward the center.                                                                                                  |
| `flare`   | number  | `0.3`        | 0 – 4   | Glow at the center at the fastest point.                                                                                                                       |
| `samples` | integer | `16`         | 2 – 32  | Samples along each streak: more are smoother.                                                                                                                  |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                   |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `warp`   | `zoom: 0.6`, `streaks: 0.75`, `flare: 0.4` |
| `punch`  | `zoom: 0.3`, `streaks: 0.4`, `flare: 0`    |
| `corner` | `center: [0.8, 0.7]`                       |

Apply one with `zoomTransition({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.9 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-depth` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 6.0 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/zoom-transition`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Radial & zoom blur](./radial-blur) — Blurs toward or around a center point: a zoom burst that rushes at the viewer, or a spin like a rotating camera.
- [Morph](./morph) — Flows one image into the next along a displacement field: the old image is pushed away as it fades while the new one settles into place.
- [Crossfade & luma wipe](./crossfade) — Blends to the next image everywhere at once, through noise, or along a luma pattern (linear, radial, diamond or spiral) with a soft edge that can glow in the theme accent.
